'''Yoda's holocron''' was a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that was made by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. It was small and contained details on various aspects of the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]]. It was kept in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and was taken by [[Jax Pavan]] when he fled the Temple during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

==Behind the scenes==
Yoda's holocron was mentioned for the first and only time on page 38 of the [[2008]] novel ''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''.
